model: released Fast-WAM Optional-IDM clean checkpoint; idm mode

transform.name: smooth05_hadamard
transform.source: reuse exact saved transforms from original successful full banks; no refitting or alpha search

selection.plus_state_rule: request official state1; if and only if the selected fresh Plus variant has exactly one official state, use state0 and record requested/actual/count/reason; no variant reselection

weight_scope: all 614 target Linears; video306/action307/root-proprio1; no highprecision restoration branch
activation: dynamic per-row signed symmetric absmax A4 qmax7; decoded BF16
unquantized: KV cache, bias, normalization, nonlinearities, text encoder, VAE and other non-target modules

vq.row_scale_initialization: row RMS with numerical floor; round to saved precision before encoding

row_scale_objective: reuse recomputed original candidate-specific decoded-Q4-input diagonal second moment; add row scale only to existing additive format
output_objective: A4-input local-output fitting; two block-Gram index-reassignment sweeps accepted only if the actual fitting objective improves, followed by up to 64 fixed-index book/scale updates

calibration_reservoir.sampling: two deterministic uniform rows from every call and calibration context, including conditioning; no late-step truncation; retain call/context identity and N/n projection scaling; projected squares remain a sampled proxy
calibration_reservoir.row_budget: two sampled rows per actual invocation, across the eight fixed calibration contexts; retain every call; actual module/call/row counts are logged

action_sensitivity.reference: first10 x 6 normalized final motor actions on original BF16 teacher trajectory
action_sensitivity.objective: mean per-module baseline-normalized local-output loss plus lambda times globally baseline-normalized sampled final-action projected half-MSE; static shared codebooks fitted in declared module order by coordinate updates
action_sensitivity.shared_weight_rule: sum per-call projected contributions within a context before squaring; do not claim sum of per-step squared errors is full shared-weight sensitivity
action_sensitivity.claim_scope: sampled first-order action projection proxy; validate with actual quantized final action queries
action_sensitivity.index_assignment: combine local input block Gram and shared-weight action-probe block metric; two reassignment sweeps with fixed books/scales, accepted only on actual objective improvement before continuous fitting
action_sensitivity.cross_module_rule: start each lambda from the same row-scale banks; sum sampled projections across all fitted modules and calls, update one module while holding all other encoded banks fixed; retain the cross-module offset
action_sensitivity.lambda_initialization: each candidate starts from the identical row-scale banks; selection only, no test queries before freeze

selection_rule: freeze action lambda using lowest four-case mean of paired motor RMSE, seeds averaged within case; tie uses declared lambda order; no test outcomes before freeze
primary_metric: case mean over two seeds of first10 x 6 motor RMSE versus own same-input same-seed original BF16
unit: fixed observation; two sampler seeds are paired repeats, not independent scenes; Plus variants can share underlying tasks
claim_scope: new held-out observations within familiar tasks and disjoint selected Plus variants; not unseen-task generalization, success rate or native-kernel latency
sampler: 10 video + 10 action denoising steps; normalized action chunk [32,7]

preflight.purpose: encoding/toy assertions, teacher differentiable parity, genuine nonzero final-action sensitivity and bounded runtime/memory; no method selection
preflight.sensitivity_scope: all 614 target Linears; numerical codebook fitting restricted to the three declared modules only; other new-arm target weights use transformed BF16, so no method-effect conclusion

baseline_transfer: after Fast-WAM numerical mechanism is established, adapt the same objectives to CosmosPolicy and LingBot-VA with their own inputs/schedulers/actions; this protocol is the first Fast-WAM campaign
design_software_reference: Kassis, T., Agarwal, V., He, Y., Patel, D., & Brueckner, A. M. (2026). Scientific Agent Skills: A Library of Procedural Knowledge for Research Agents. arXiv:2609.00065, current version v2 verified 2026-10-09. https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2609.00065

implementation_controls.fitting_compute: FP32 sampled Linear proxy with saved BF16 weights/books/scales in forward
